newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London fall in sleepy trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London fall in sleepy trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were down very slightly on Thursday in trading characterised by a distinct lack of interest, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index ended down 13.83 points at 13,477.73, from Wednesday's close of 13,426.64.
In Hong Kong the Hang Seng Index ended at 13,491.56, up on the previous close of 13,434.24.
"There is a complete lack of interest," said one marketmaker. He admitted being a little puzzled, as he expected Hong Kong stocks to be weaker on the back of a fall in U.S. bonds.
One trader described the day's business as "nonexistent". -- Nick Winning + 44 171 542 7954
